propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the ticket-routing service's automated test suites and release-gate checks and added a routing-rule regression pack.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the gate configuration document the suites and checks.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate analysed escaped defects fortnightly and recorded root causes and prevention actions in the quality log.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the quality log document the analysis.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate owned quality for the ticket-routing service end-to-end and held the weekly go/no-go.
propositions.rationale: The resume assigns scope to the development lead and the go/no-go to the release manager; 'rubber-stamped' and 'really ran quality' describe influence and opinion, not authority held.

expectedGap: The materials show suites, gate checks and defect analysis; they do not show the candidate holding the go/no-go or setting release scope.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the boundary the resume states: scope by the development lead, go/no-go by the release manager; the candidate recommended.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate ever held the go/no-go himself and for which releases, and who could overrule his recommendation.
